event: ThunderTalk Gaming vs Team WE — Game 1
draftAssessmentContext: WE was assessed to hold the draft advantage.

outcomeInterpretation.draftDiffNotDeterministic: A draft edge changes expected win probability but does not determine the result. Execution, lane outcomes, fight selection, objective conversion, item timing, and opponent errors can overcome it.
outcomeInterpretation.ttFunctionalCapacity: TT's K'Sante, Jarvan IV, Ryze, Ziggs, and Shen composition retained waveclear, layered engage and counter-engage, global or semi-global map influence, and two meaningful damage channels. Those features supplied real comeback and conversion routes even if WE held the cleaner theoretical draft.
outcomeInterpretation.modelLesson: Use draft disadvantage as a price and fragility input, not as a blanket veto when the underdog retains functioning damage, target access, stabilization tools, and a large handicap cushion.
outcomeInterpretation.expiryStillCorrect: The later TT +9.5 thesis expiry remained procedurally correct after WE's structured-fight win and three-Grub control because the live state had materially changed. TT's eventual win does not make an expired price actionable in hindsight.
